h1: Asia Lampang Hotel — a central old-town Lampang hotel within walking distance of Kad Kong Ta, with roomy rooms, free parking and budget prices
intro: Picture a long-standing hotel in central Lampang, sitting on Bunyawat Road in the old-town core, just a few minutes' walk from Kad Kong Ta, the riverside walking street along the Wang River — Asia Lampang Hotel is the kind of place guests pick for its central location, roomy rooms, free parking and budget prices. It's a 3-star hotel with over 70 rooms, an on-site restaurant and a 24-hour front desk, from approx. ฿650/night · scored 8.0 from real guest reviews — not a shiny new boutique, but a sensible fit for anyone who wants to sleep in the heart of town without spending much.

body.html: Asia Lampang Hotel is at 229 Bunyawat Road, Suan Dok, Mueang Lampang · what guests mention most is its central old-town location within walking distance of Kad Kong Ta and the Wang River, its roomy rooms and convenient free parking · it's a mid-size hotel of over 70 rooms that has been part of Lampang for years. Travelers driving around Lampang, wanting to sleep in town and wander in the evening, or simply looking for a budget stay with parking tend to choose it, because you can step out of the hotel and walk straight into Kad Kong Ta and the old quarter.

What guests agree on most is that the rooms are spacious, clean enough and good value · many reviews say rooms are larger than expected for a high-hundreds to low-thousand-baht rate, the air-con is cold, hot water works, and there's a fridge and TV · room types run from Superior to family rooms for groups · guests say getting a roomy, central room with parking at this price stands out for Lampang, especially for travelers who aren't chasing a brand-new design hotel and just want a comfortable place close to food.
"Great location, you can walk to Kad Kong Ta, the room was spacious, parking was easy and the price was budget-friendly — perfect for driving to Lampang and staying right in town."

The hotel's other strength is that its central location is genuinely walkable · from the hotel it's a few minutes on foot to Kad Kong Ta, the evening walking street along the Wang River that opens only on Saturdays and Sundays · the area around it is full of restaurants, cafes, markets and local food to graze on · there's an on-site restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, an elevator and free Wi-Fi · the perk drivers love most is the free parking in the old quarter, which is hard to come by here, so you can drive in, park and explore the old town without circling for a spot.

Now for the honest part: this is an older hotel and its age shows · many reviews note the building and rooms look dated and that some areas could use a refresh, with furniture and bathrooms that aren't new · the styling is old-school hotel rather than modern boutique · breakfast is mainly Thai/Asian, so guests expecting a Western spread may find the choices limited · if you're after a brand-new room, sharp design or resort-style facilities, this isn't that.

Facilities also need to be judged against the price · there's no swimming pool, gym or spa here — it's a central budget-friendly base rather than a destination in itself · because it sits in the heart of town on a main road, some rooms may catch street noise or sound from nearby activity, so light sleepers should ask for an inner room · the 8.0 score from real guest reviews reflects exactly that picture: location and price are the selling points, while newness and design are not.

Overall, Asia Lampang Hotel is about central location, roomy rooms, free parking and budget pricing rather than newness or design · it suits travelers who want to sleep in the heart of Lampang, walk to Kad Kong Ta and the old town, have a car and want parking, all on a manageable budget · if you're after a new, clean hotel with an onsen, or a riverside resort with a pool, this isn't the answer · but if what you want is a central spot within walking distance of food, a roomy room, easy parking and a light price — it does that job, and does it for real value.

A tip from those who follow the reviews here: if you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room away from the main road, since the central location can bring some noise · Kad Kong Ta only opens on Saturday and Sunday nights, so plan a weekend stay if you want the walking street · the cool season (November–February) is Lampang's high season and rooms fill quickly, so book ahead and compare a few platforms first, as breakfast-included rates can differ.

honestSummary: Asia Lampang Hotel is best for travelers who want a central Lampang base within walking distance of Kad Kong Ta, with roomy rooms, free parking and a budget price · its charm is the genuinely walkable old-town location, spacious rooms and easy parking, not newness or design · you have to accept that it's an older hotel where the building and some rooms could use a refresh, there's no pool, and some rooms may catch street noise — but in exchange you get a central, walk-to-food location and light prices that are hard to find in this area.
honestChecks: If you expect a new hotel with stylish, modern rooms — this is an older property whose building and some rooms could use a refresh → for newness and design, consider a newer boutique in town such as The Space or Tree Thara instead.
If you want a pool or a resort feel — there's no pool here and it's a central budget stay → for a pool or riverside atmosphere, look at the Wang River-side properties instead.

If you're a light sleeper sensitive to noise — it sits in the heart of town on a main road and some rooms may catch street noise → ask for an inner room away from the road when booking or checking in.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Asia Lampang Hotel

faq.q: Where is Asia Lampang Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: Asia Lampang Hotel is at 229 Bunyawat Road, Suan Dok, Mueang Lampang, in the old-town core · it's a few minutes' walk to Kad Kong Ta (the walking street) and the Wang River · close to Wat Phra Kaeo Don Tao and Lampang Railway Station · about a 25-minute drive on to Wat Phra That Lampang Luang.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from approx. ฿650/night for a Superior Double · options run from Superior Twin and Deluxe up to a Family Room for groups · cool-season rates (Nov–Feb) rise and rooms fill quickly as it's Lampang's high season, so compare a few platforms first as breakfast-included rates can differ.

faq.q: Who is Asia Lampang Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for travelers who want to sleep in the heart of Lampang, walk to Kad Kong Ta and the old town, have roomy rooms and parking, all on a budget · it works well for drivers exploring Lampang or stopping over · it's less suited to those after a new design hotel, a pool, or a resort feel.

faq.q: What are the rooms and facilities like at Asia Lampang Hotel?
faq.a: Rooms are spacious with air-con, TV, fridge, hot water and free Wi-Fi, ranging from Superior to Family Rooms · there's an on-site restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, an elevator and free parking · there's no pool, gym or spa — it's a central, budget-friendly stay.

faq.q: What should I know before staying at Asia Lampang Hotel?
faq.a: Reviews note that it's an older hotel where the building and some rooms could use a refresh and the styling isn't modern · there's no pool, breakfast is mainly Thai/Asian with limited choices, and because it's in the heart of town on a main road, some rooms may catch street noise — light sleepers should ask for an inner room.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and is cancellation possible?
faq.a: In the cool season (November–February), book several weeks ahead, as it's Lampang's high season and rooms fill fast · at other times a few days is usually enough · every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that if your plans aren't firm, and compare a few platforms before booking.
